title: SEC6: DeliverClient generic bound makes outbox_worker testable
description: outbox_tick and outbox_worker are generic over C: DeliverClient. This means the retry/backoff logic is fully testable with MockClient or FailingClient without spawning a real HTTPS server or using process isolation. The trait requires only deliver_msg, which maps cleanly to PeerHttpClient::deliver in production. The borrow checker enforces that the lock is dropped before the .await on deliver_msg because MutexGuard is not Send — the generic bound actually tightens the lock discipline guarantee rather than weakening it.
